Contract LibraryManagementSystemSystem::borrowBook(uid: String,barcode: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(u|u.UserID = uid),
		bookCopy: BookCopy = BookCopy.allInstance()->any(bc|bc.Barcode = barcode)
	precondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		bookCopy.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		bookCopy.Status = BookCopy::AVAILABLE and
		user.BorrowStatus = User::NORMAL
	postcondition:
		let loan: Loan in
		loan.oclIsNew() and
		Loan.allInstance()->includes(loan) and
		loan.LoanedUser = user and
		loan.LoanedCopy = bookCopy and
		loan.LoanDate = LibraryManagementSystemSystem.currentDate and
		loan.IsReturned = false and
		user.LoanedBook->includes(loan) and
		bookCopy.Status = BookCopy::LOANED and
		bookCopy.LoanedRecord->includes(loan) and
		result = true
}
